name: itmecasey-tip-relay
description: Instant PayPal tip alerts: receives PayPal's IPN and forwards it to the streamer's app

RELAY_TOKEN.description: The key the app shows on its Tips page. It lets only your PC read your tips.

PAYPAL_EMAIL.description: PayPal only: the email of your PayPal Business account. Ko-fi users type none.

KOFI_PAGE.description: Ko-fi only: your Ko-fi name (ko-fi.com/yourname). PayPal users type none.

KOFI_TOKEN.description: Ko-fi only: the verification token from Ko-fi's API settings. PayPal users type none.
